title: Practice 4: Accusative endings: nouns, adjectives, pronouns

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Катрин хотела пойти в ___ (торговый, acc. sg. m.) центр.
exercises.prompt: Catherine wanted to go to the shopping center.
exercises.why: **торговый → торговый** (acc. sg. m., agreeing with центр). Adjective type I, hard — declines like DLI's новый (every form has the same endings): A. anim. = G., inan. = N. No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension of торговый (m.): торговый · торгового · торговому · торговый (inan.) / торгового (anim.) · торговым · торговом; plural: торговые · торговых · торговым · торговые (inan.) / торговых (anim.) · торговыми · торговых.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  Adjectives in the accusative: animate = genitive, inanimate = nominative (masculine and plural); feminine -ую, -юю. — DLI, Lessons 46–47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Не нажимай на ___ (спусковой, acc. sg. m.) крючок.
exercises.prompt: Don't pull the trigger.
exercises.why: **спусковой → спусковой** (acc. sg. m., agreeing with крючок). Adjective type I, hard — declines like DLI's новый (every form has the same endings, apart from the masculine nominative singular (and the inanimate accusative equal to it), which ends in -ой here, not -ый): A. anim. = G., inan. = N. Adjectives in the accusative: animate = genitive, inanimate = nominative (masculine and plural); feminine -ую, -юю. — DLI, Lessons 46–47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).
